_comment: Hand-built in the Graph API's shape (/graph/v1/researchProducts), unlike the recorded openaire.json. Each case is one the normaliser has to survive; several were first met on the legacy endpoint and are kept because the data behind them is the same graph.

a stray numeric description before the real abstract, and a subtitle beside the main title — shapes first met on a live `alzheimer amyloid beta` page

descriptions: Alzheimer's disease is the most common neurodegenerative disorder to date.
